title: The Real Reason Pirates Wore Eye Patches
hook: Eye patches kept one eye adjusted to pitch-black cargo holds.

scenes.text: Every classic pirate illustration shows a menacing buccaneer sporting a black leather eye patch over one eye.
scenes.imagePrompt: Weathered pirate captain's hat and round leather eye patch resting on a wooden table beside brass navigation charts. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: Every classic pirate illustration shows a menacing buccaneer sporting a black leather eye patch over one eye.

scenes.text: While some sailors lost eyes to flying wood splinters or sparking gunpowder burns, many wore patches with two perfectly good eyes.

scenes.text: The human eye takes up to twenty minutes to adapt from bright tropical sunlight into pitch-black indoor darkness.

scenes.text: During chaotic boarding raids, fighting often moved in seconds from the blinding sun on deck down into dark cargo holds.
